Indonesia Ferry Fire: Five Dead, 41 Missing

A ferry carrying 271 people caught fire off Indonesia's Madura island. Five people died and 41 are missing, while 225 were rescued. The cause of the fire is currently unknown. Rescue operations are ongoing, with multiple ships deployed to search for the missing.
